standard.summary: 编辑训练的监督 loss 以 target denoising/flow/noise loss 为基线，可额外使用 edit_mask_weight 强化编辑区域，用 edit_preserve_weight 约束保留区域。
standard.effect: edit_mask_weight > 1 时，mask 区域的 target 误差会更重要。edit_preserve_weight > 0 时，preserve_mask 区域会额外加入保持损失。
standard.whenToUse: paired 数据有编辑 mask 或保留 mask 时。没有 mask 时保持默认 target loss。
standard.avoidWhen: mask 与 target 不对齐、mask 来源不可靠，或只是普通 LoRA caption 训练时。

optionDescriptions.target: 以 target 扩散/flow 损失打底，可再叠 mask/preserve 权重。

standard_en.summary: Supervision for edit training is based on the target denoising/flow/noise loss, with edit_mask_weight available to emphasise the edit region and edit_preserve_weight to constrain the region being kept.
standard_en.effect: With edit_mask_weight > 1, target error inside the mask counts for more. With edit_preserve_weight > 0, the preserve_mask region gains an additional preservation loss.
standard_en.whenToUse: When the paired data carries an edit mask or a preserve mask. Without a mask, keep the default target loss.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When the mask does not line up with the target, the mask's provenance is unreliable, or this is just ordinary LoRA caption training.

optionDescriptions.target: Built on the target diffusion/flow loss, with mask and preserve weights available on top.

advanced.principle: 第一版不引入 VLM/CLIP reward 依赖，只在已有 diffusion target loss 上叠加确定性的 mask/preserve delta，避免训练路径膨胀。
advanced.intervention: loss execution stage 在基础 target loss 后追加 edit loss delta，并记录小型 edit_loss 报告。
advanced.expectedImpact: 让模型把学习容量集中到目标编辑区域，同时减少非编辑区域漂移。
advanced.tradeoffs: preserve loss 目前复用 target-space 误差；source-vs-target latent preservation 需要后续 source encode 路径。

advanced_en.principle: V1 introduces no VLM/CLIP reward dependency — only deterministic mask/preserve deltas stacked on the existing diffusion target loss, avoiding training-path bloat.
advanced_en.intervention: The loss execution stage appends the edit loss delta after the base target loss and records a small edit_loss report.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Concentrates the model's learning capacity on the target edit region while reducing drift elsewhere.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The preserve loss currently reuses target-space error; source-vs-target latent preservation needs a later source-encode path.
